releases.name: landstrip 0.20.10
releases.body:
Landstrip 0.20.10

landstrip:
- lockfiles: record the restored CLI package (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- ci: install CLI, API, and platform tarballs (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: version and publish the CLI package (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- cli: restore @landstrip/landstrip CLI package (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: broker access(2) policy checks (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: permit metadata updates on unlinked files (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

opencode-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.20.10 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- extensions: check the restored CLI package (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- lockfiles: record the restored CLI package (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

pi-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.20.10 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- extensions: check the restored CLI package (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- lockfiles: record the restored CLI package (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

Signed-off-by: Jarkko Sakkinen <jarkko.sakkinen@iki.fi>
